sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "exclude_from_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_total" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_hint" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "fx_rate_micros" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "place" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0 OR (type = 'adjustment' AND amount_minor <> 0)), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (to_account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (to_account_id IS NULL OR to_account_id <> account_id), CHECK (to_amount_minor IS NULL OR to_amount_minor > 0), CHECK (type = 'transfer' OR (to_amount_minor IS NULL AND fx_rate_micros IS NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_events" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "event_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK (cycle_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "template" TEXT NOT NULL, "freq" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "day_rule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'clampToMonthEnd', "next_run_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (interval >= 1));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "row_counts" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_hashes" ("hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("hash"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_active_name ON accounts (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_active_name ON categories (kind, name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX people_active_name ON people (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX transactions_occurred_at ON transactions (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX transactions_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_to_account ON transactions (to_account_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_person ON transactions (person_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tags_name ON tags (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_name ON events (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_cycle_category ON budgets (ifnull(category_id, ''), cycle_year, cycle_month)
